post.caption: Whoopi Goldberg refused to wear rhinestones. In the 1997 TV film Cinderella, she played a queen, and the costume team first made her rhinestone jewelry. She insisted the queen wear real jewels instead, so she called Harry Winston herself and asked to borrow some. The loan included a 70 carat diamond ring, and Winston sent three armed guards to the set. In 1999, she hosted the Academy Awards in Elizabethan costume and reportedly wore 41 million dollars of Winston jewels, an Oscars record. One diamond ring in that collection was worth 15 million dollars.
